faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-2 recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-2 position is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Research Scientist-2 post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class or Second Class Post Graduate Degree (MSc/MTech) in Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, or Genomics, along with at least three years of relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist-2 position is 40 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, which can be found in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-2 role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000 per month, plus 27% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Project Research Scientist-2 position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Candidates are advised to prepare well for both stages.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist-2 post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-2 position at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is required for this post?
faq.answer: The required experience includes at least three years of work experience in bioinformatics analysis, wet lab processing, and familiarity with sequencing platforms.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of AIIMS Delhi. Links are provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
